effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) Then, by trashing 1 Option card in the battle area, this Digimon gains ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.) and ＜Security A. +1＞ for the turn. (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When Option cards in the battle area are trashed, 1 of your opponent's Digimon can't digivolve or attack players until their turn ends.
